title: Group Guided Walking Food Tour of Hyannis and Local Insights
blurb:
The Cape Cod Food Tour offers a delightful culinary adventure through historic Hyannis, where food lovers can savor a range of local delicacies. Stroll along the charming main street and to the picturesque harbor while stopping at only locally owned and operated restaurants and shops and sampling fresh, house-made, local authentic dishes from various restaurants. A fun and knowledgeable guide will take care of everything! They will share stories about the food, restaurants and shops and the owners. You will learn some great facts and history about cape cod and uncover Hyannis' rich history. This tour is ideal for all. explore the local culture through its cuisine and history.

- 3-hour guided walking tour showcasing the best of Hyannis food
- Sample dishes from renowned local restaurants while learning about the owners and restaurants and food
- Ideal for families, groups, friends and couples of any age
- Comfortable walking shoes, dress in layers, bring rain gear if applicable.
